title: feat: add tencent/hy4-preview via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15138

## Summary
- Adds `tencent/hy4-preview` as a new paid-only text model (no aliases), routed through OpenRouter, pinned to its only endpoint (`tencent/fp8` tag — Tencent is the sole provider)
- Pricing: $0.834/M input, $2.501/M output, $0.042/M cache read — verified live against OpenRouter's `/api/v1/models/tencent/hy4-preview/endpoints`
- Context 1,048,576, max output 64,000 (also verified live)
- `priceMultiplier: 1`, `paidOnly: true`

Currently #1 on OpenRouter's weekly usage rankings (17.8T tokens processed, +31% week-over-week), and Tencent wasn't represented in the catalog at all before this.

## Contract (confirmed)
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Canonical name | `tencent/hy4-preview` |
| Aliases | none |
| Registry provider | `openrouter` |
| Primary route | OpenRouter `tencent/fp8` tag (only endpoint) |
| Fallback | none found — single endpoint, no existing Tencent integration elsewhere in the repo |
| Pollinations GPU | no |

## Notes
- Forced `tool_choice` isn't supported by this endpoint (only `auto`/`none` per `supports_tool_choice`), so `tools` is declared without `tool_choice`, matching the existing convention for similarly-limited models
- No `top_p`, penalties, `seed`, or logprobs in the endpoint's `supported_parameters` — declared parameter set reflects exactly what's live
- Text-only input (no vision) on this endpoint
- Adds a placeholder Tencent brand logo (`frontend/public/brand-logos/tencent.svg`) since no verified official vector was available — required by `pricing-data.test.ts`'s catalog logo-resolution test, same convention already used for Thinking Machines and Sakana AI

## Verification
- Pricing/context/max-output/supported-params confirmed against OpenRouter's public endpoints API
- Added a unit test (`modelResolver.test.ts`) asserting the pinned `provider.only`/`allow_fallbacks` shape
- Updated the `effective-prices` snapshot in `enter.pollinations.ai`
